verses.gurmukhi: ਸੰਗਮ ਸੰਜੋਗ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਨੇਮ ਕਉ ਪਤੰਗੁ ਜਾਨੈ ਬਿਰਹ ਬਿਓਗ ਸੋਗ ਮੀਨ ਭਲ ਜਾਨਈ ॥
verses.translit_en: sa(n)gam sa(n)jog prem nem kau pata(n)g jaanai bireh biog sog meen bhal jaaniee ||

en.bdb: The loving atmosphere that gets generated when a lover is about to meet his beloved can best be known by a moth. The pang of separation is best described by a fish that has been separated from its beloved water.

verses.gurmukhi: ਇਕ ਟਕ ਦੀਪਕ ਧਿਆਨ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਪਰਹਰੈ ਸਲਿਲ ਬਿਓਗ ਮੀਨ ਜੀਵਨ ਨ ਮਾਨਈ ॥
verses.translit_en: eik Tak dheepak dhiaan praan paraharai salil biog meen jeevan na maaniee ||

en.bdb: A moth burns itself for the love of the flame that he keeps watching and playing with. Similarly a fish separated from water has no meaning of life. She dies when out of it.

verses.gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਮਿਲਿ ਬਿਛੁਰੈ ਮਧੁਪ ਮਨ ਕਪਟ ਸਨੇਹ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਜਨਮ ਅਗਿਆਨਈ ॥
verses.translit_en: charan kamal mil bichhurai madhup man kapaT saneh dhirag janam agiaaniee ||

en.bdb: These beings lay down their lives in love of their beloveds. Contrarily, an evil person's mind, like a black bee, hops from one flower to another, knowingly seperating from the holy feet of True Guru. Human life is a waste and a curse for such a person.

verses.gurmukhi: ਨਿਹਫਲ ਜੀਵਨ ਮਰਨ ਗੁਰ ਬਿਮੁਖ ਹੁਇ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਅਰੁ ਬਿਰਹ ਨ ਦੋਊ ਉਰ ਆਨਈ ॥੩੦੦॥
verses.translit_en: nihafal jeevan maran gur bimukh hui prem ar bireh na dhouoo ur aaniee ||300||

en.bdb: A follower of his own heart turned away from the refuge of the Guru, who does not feel the pangs of separation and love of the holy feet of the. True Guru, has wasted away his birth and death thus living a worthless life. (300)
